questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some goats are eagles.

All eagles are snakes.

No duck is an eagle.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No snake is a goat.

(II) Some ducks are snakes is a possibility.

(III) Some ducks are not goats

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1449eb76a4712ca3448d911f3f79a59717f764aaffe5bd59b61b2df02eadec21.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No snake is a goat → Does not Follow (As, some goats are eagles and all eagles are snakes, So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some ducks are snakes is a possibility → Follow (As, no duck is an eagle and all eagles are snakes. and, no definite relation is given between snakes and duck, so some ducks are snakes can be possible therefore it is definitely true)

III. Some ducks are not goats → Does not Follow (As, some goats are eagles, all eagles are snakes and no duck is an eagle. So, no definite relation is given between goats and duck, so some ducks are not goats can be possible but not definitely true)

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion II follows".

Which of the following cell divisions is known as reduction division?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Meiosis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meiosis**:-

 
 
• **It is known as reduction division because it reduces the number of chromosomes in a cell by half, resulting in four haploid daughter cells.**
 
• This process is essential for sexual reproduction as it allows for the formation of gametes with half the number of chromosomes as the parent cell, which then combine during fertilization to form a zygote with a full set of chromosomes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Telophase:-**

 
 
• It is a stage in both mitosis and meiosis where the nuclear membrane reforms around the separated chromosomes, but it is not known as reduction division.
 
 
 
• **Prophase:-**
 
 
• It is the stage in both mitosis and meiosis where the chromatin condenses into visible chromosomes, but it is not known as reduction division.
 
 
 
• **Mitosis:-**
 
 
• It is a type of cell division where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells, each with the same number of chromosomes as the parent cell.
 
• It does not involve a reduction in chromosome number and is not known as reduction division.

questions.question: Two numbers, when divided by a certain divisor, leave the remainder 57. When sum of the two numbers is divided by the same divisor, the remainder is 49. The divisor is:

Given:

When two different number is divided by the same divisor the remainder are 57 and 57 respectively. And when the sum of these two numbers is divided by the same divisor the remainder is 49.

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

Let the divisor be ‘d’ and the quotient be q₁ for the dividend x, q₂ for the dividend y and q₃ for the dividend (x + y)

∴ By the given condition,

x = q₁ × d + 57

y = q₂ × d + 57

And (x + y) = q₃ × d + 49

Since q₁, q₂, q₃ are whole numbers and in all cases, the remainder are 57, 57 and 49 then it is obvious that the divisor d > 57

∴ (x – 57), (y – 57) and (x + y – 49) all will completely divisible by d ….(1)

∴ {(x – 57 + (y – 57)} is also completely divisible by d

⇒ (x + y – 114) is also completely divisible by d ….(2)

Now, from (1) and (2) we can write {(x + y – 49) – (x + y – 114)} = 65, must be divisible by ‘d’ or ‘d’ be a factor of 65

Now, factors of 65 are 1, 5, 13 and 65

Since d > 57, the value of ‘d’ must be 65
